lines.q: In which year did humans first walk on the Moon?
lines.a: Nineteen sixty nine! In July, to be exact.

lines.q: What is a shooting star really?
lines.a: A meteor! A space rock burning up in our air.

lines.q: Who was the first American in space?
lines.a: Alan Shepard! John Glenn was first to orbit.

lines.q: What color is the Sun really?
lines.a: White! Our air makes it look yellow.

lines.q: How long does the International Space Station take to circle Earth?
lines.a: About ninety minutes! Sixteen sunrises a day.

lines.q: Last one. What was the name of the first dog in orbit?
lines.a: Laika! Back in nineteen fifty seven. Got all six? Go again!
